title: Interplay of student characteristics multidimensional engagement and influencing factors in online computer science education
reason: Questionnaire survey of 267 computer-science undergraduates relating self-reported daily online-study duration and self/teacher/peer factors to self-reported engagement by Pearson r. All variables are self-report; no platform-recorded indicator or activity product.

extraction.country: China ('H University' in central China; Huanggang Normal University affiliation)
extraction.n_quote: we employed a simple stratified random sampling method and selected 267 students as the research sample.
extraction.lms_indicators: none (daily online learning duration is self-reported in the questionnaire)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: behavioural, cognitive, emotional and interactive engagement (self-report)
extraction.notes: Self-report duration ↔ self-report engagement, e.g. 'the correlation coefficient for Behavioral Engagement is 0.264 ( p < 0.000)'; not an LMS indicator. This DOI (10.1038/s41598-025-90142-9) is one of the co-author's Copilot candidates; it does not qualify.
